find: if (blockedAt(i + di * span, j + dj * span) && blockedAt(i - di * span, j - dj * span)) {
replace: if (blockedAt(i + di * span, j + dj * span) || blockedAt(i - di * span, j - dj * span)) {
why: Counts a point beside a SINGLE wall face as corridor-narrow, which is the bug this measure actually shipped with twice before its fixtures were satisfied. With `||`, the narrow bands hugging every interior wall face join separate gaps into one connected run, so blocking that run blocks every route at once and a board with two ways through the same wall still reports its tunnel as unavoidable. A corridor has wall on BOTH sides; a wall face has open room on one of them. The two-route control is the assertion that separates them.
killedBy: mapgen quality measures: bot jam corridors (issue #822) stops counting the same tunnel once a second route exists
